                "%s.json" % spec["role"],)},

            "deliver_refusals": len(audit.get("deliver_refusals") or []),
            "deliver_refusal_chars": sum(audit.get("deliver_refusals") or []),
            "thinking_chars": audit.get("thinking_chars"), "thinking_tokens": audit.get("thinking_tokens"),
